content.description: Cross-sectional view of starter showing field frame with armature and magnetic switch

content.text: 1. REMOVE FIELD FRAME WITH ARMATURE FROM MAGNETIC SWITCH

items: (a) Disconnect the lead wire from the magnetic switch terminal.
(b) Remove the two bolts. Pull out the field frame with the armature from the magnetic switch.

content.text: 2. REMOVE STARTER HOUSING FROM MAGNETIC SWITCH ASSEMBLY
Remove the two screws and remove the starter housing.

content.description: Hand using screwdriver to remove screws from starter housing of magnetic switch assembly

content.text: 3. REMOVE CLUTCH ASSEMBLY AND GEARS FROM MAGNETIC SWITCH ASSEMBLY
Using a magnet, remove the steel ball from the clutch shaft hole.

content.description: Using a magnet to remove steel ball from clutch assembly

items: (a) Remove the end cover from the field frame.
(c) Using a screwdriver, separate the brush and brush spring, and remove the brush from the brush holder.
(d) Pull the brush holder off the armature.

content.description: Removing brush holder and brushes from armature assembly

content.text: 1. CHECK THAT COMMUTATOR IS NOT GROUNDED
Using an ohmmeter, check that there is no continuity between the commutator and armature coil core.
If there is continuity, replace the armature.

content.description: Using ohmmeter to check armature coil commutator for ground
